messages:
jamie: Quick FYI — going to change frontend-statefulset -> replicas: 3, add podAntiAffinity for region spread, and tweak updateStrategy to RollingUpdate with partition-based canary. Anyone relying on stable ordinals/hostnames? Also will adjust resource requests (cpu/mem).

ana: Do we need to update the PDB? minAvailable is currently 2 — if we set replicas to 3 maybe set minAvailable to 1? worried about availability during upgrades.

dmitri: Heads-up: check PVC binding mode. If we move pods across nodes, bound volumes may not follow. For StatefulSet we keep stable hostnames, but anti-affinity + PVs can conflict. If RWX not available, we should avoid cross-zone anti-affinity.

ev an: For readiness probe, switch to /healthz with initialDelaySeconds: 1 and periodSeconds: 3. Also note rolling partitioning for sts is how you can canary one pod: 
```yaml
updateStrategy:
  type: RollingUpdate
  rollingUpdate:
    partition: 1
```
maxUnavailable doesn't apply to StatefulSet.

jamie: Thanks — I'll set partition: 1 for the canary (one pod stays old). I'll lower PDB to minAvailable: 1. Plan: update helm values in infra repo (helm_release -> values.frontend) via Terraform and open a PR. Ping me for review.

ana: Also add a note in the helm values that HPA won't scale a StatefulSet; if we want autoscaling we need HPA on a Deployment or use KEDA. cc @dmitri

dmitri: Ack. I'll check the PV types and confirm RWX availability in the cluster. If RWX isn't available, keep anti-affinity within same zone only.

deploy-bot: PR created: infra/terraform#482 — includes helm values bump, replicas=3, partition=1, updated readiness probe. Link: https://git.company/infra/pulls/482 :eyes:

jamie: Nice. @evan can you review the readiness probe change in the PR? I'll run the canary tomorrow morning (US-west). :thumbsup:

ev an: Will review today. Also add a short smoke test to run after rollout: `scripts/smoke_frontend.sh`

jamie: Great. I'll add a short runbook note in the PR description about rollback steps (scale replicas back to 1, set partition to 0) and deploy window.

ana: One more quick check — are there any SLI changes? tokenization service depends on stable hostnames for leader election? If so we need a separate plan.

dmitri: Good catch. I don't think tokenization uses ordinal leader election, but I'll validate. If it does, we should keep hostname stability and not do cross-node anti-affinity.

jamie: OK, holding off on cross-zone anti-affinity until PV and tokenization checks are clear. Will update the PR with the PDB change and readiness probe snippet. Thanks everyone.
